propositions: A declared-none file impact must preserve certified attestation across unrelated commits without re-hashing, while undeclared or unscoped empty-impact records still trigger whole-HEAD freshness checks.
The manifest must emit exactly one authenticated `file-scope: none` declaration for none-scoped records; paths and unscoped output must be byte-identical to pre-feature serialization.
A none declaration present only in unauthenticated plaintext cannot suppress stale-head validity; only signed authenticated manifests are authoritative.
Scope classification into paths/none/unscoped must be deterministic based on dependency paths and effective own scope, with container_all_none as a future seam parameter.
Material fingerprint must include a canonical basis member for none scope with reason only, making reason-only edits stale while preserving legacy fingerprint bytes for paths and unscoped.
Recovery via resign_plan_review must preserve none scope through the same signing boundary without additional branches, and old readers must treat missing file-scope as unscoped.
